request.description:
**Requirement:** Cross-Service Session Revocation Contract & API Standard (Confluence 524593) — Notification v1 mutation endpoints must reject Bearer tokens belonging to logged-out sessions with HTTP 401 AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED.

**OWASP Mapping:** OWASP A07:2025 Authentication Failures (CWE-613) & A01:2025 · OWASP API2:2023

**Single-Variable Delta:** Replace active Bearer token with Bearer token invalidated via POST /api/traveler/logout

**Expected Response:** HTTP 401 Unauthorized with error.code = 'AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED'.

**Expected Data Result (Readback):** Zero notification records modified after session logout.
